children: Tiernan's subsidiary signed a non-binding MoU to evaluate potential desalinated water supply of up to approximately 120 litres per second for the Volcan project. No prior-period comparison applies.
Evaluate up to ~120 L/s of desalinated water
Could provide an alternative supply for Volcan, but this is a potential maximum for evaluation, not a committed volume.
Neither party is obligated to enter a supply agreement, so the announcement does not secure water supply.
Potential agreement term: 15 years from supply start
A long-term framework is contemplated, but price, start date and final commercial terms remain unagreed.
Evaluation period: nine months, extendable by nine
The next assessment may take up to 18 months if extended before a potential definitive agreement is negotiated.
EIA base case remains permitted groundwater wells
The alternative source is being evaluated in parallel and has not replaced the project's existing base case.

This is an early-stage project infrastructure option, not confirmation of a secured water source. A larger catalyst would require a definitive agreement with disclosed price, delivery timing, committed volume and infrastructure requirements.
